title: Not hard to put together but came with scratches on the table
text: Not hard to put together but came with scratches on the table. This was easy to assemble. Legs are durable and leveled. Theres enough space for moderate amounts of makeup and lotions. However the vanity came with scratches. Noticed this once I was 75 percent finished. But kept it bc it would be more difficult to take apart and pack it back in the box.

features: Mdf, Pine Wood (Table Legs), Rubberwood (Stool Legs)

[Beaming with Charm] A rounded glass mirror, a vanity table with a upholstered stool, canted legs, and natural and white finish—this makeup vanity set fills your room with chic, modish charm, making it an essential part of your daily beauty regimen

[Oodles of Storage] With 2 sliding, deep drawers that keep makeup supplies and hairbrushes at your fingertips, and a spacious tabletop that leaves you a large space for your beauty routine, this makeup vanity covers all the bases for you to get ready
[Thoughtful Deign] The matching stool is designed with a well-padded seat for a comfortable seating experience; it also comes with a removable stool cover, which is easy to clean
[Assembly Made Simple] Follow the detailed instructions, and assemble the legs to the vanity table, and you’ll get your new vanity table ready in no time
[The Gift You Need] In need of gift ideas? Make your loved one happy, thrill your friends, or even beautify your bedroom or dressing room! A stylish, practical, and surprising gift!
[Note] For safety, be sure to secure the product to the wall with the included anti-tip kit
description: Are you looking for a unique but practical dressing table? Try this VASAGLE vanity set. It will never let you down with practical functions as well as lovely appearance. Made of superior MDF and solid wood, it is durable to use. Two large sliding drawers provide ample space for your make-up and jewelries. Protective velvet attached on the back of mirror for reducing damage if glass is broken. Comes with anti-toppling fittings underneath the table for safe use.
